summary: @or-sdk/tables preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13, platform/arch selected with musl/glibc detection), unzips it to a temp directory, chmod +x's the binary, and then execFileSyncs it against the bundled sibling math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte hex-obfuscated string-array-rotation blob carrying a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, is not referenced by dist/cjs/index.js, and has no relationship to the advertised Tables SDK. The Bun runtime is used specifically to execute a Bun-only payload whose contents are hidden from Node-level review. Fetching Bun from its official releases is legitimate on its own, but here it is combined with unconditional install-time execution of an obfuscated, purpose-mismatched, non-SDK payload — the alternate-runtime dropper pattern. The payload runs automatically on `npm install` with the installer's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
